todayOrders.title: Fostering the Future for American Children and Families
todayOrders.tone_tag: Art. I §8: Delegated Tariff & Commerce Execution
todayOrders.snippet: My Administration is dedicated to empowering mothers and fathers to raise their children in safe and loving homes. When crises prevent such an arrangement, our Nation's foster care system must be ready to serve children in need.

todayOrders.title: Executive Order 13450—Improving Government Program Performance
todayOrders.tone_tag: 10th Amend: Intergovernmental Federalism Cooperation
todayOrders.snippet: It is the policy of the Federal Government to spend taxpayer dollars effectively, and more effectively each year. Agencies shall apply taxpayer resources efficiently in a manner that maximizes the effectiveness of Government programs in serving the American people. Sec. 2.
